disclaimer: SIMULATED: these numbers come from the discrete-event simulator (internal/sim), which runs the real fairq gateway scheduler, control.Core controller and autoscale HPA/KEDA code in virtual time, with replica compute replaced by the simulated engine latency model (the config's engine parameters: illustrative unless calibrated by `tenantscaler profile`; not measured inference). Real-replica results are reported separately.

setups.name: S1-cpu-hpa
setups.controlPlane: CPU-style HPA on engine slot occupancy (target 0.7)

setups.name: S2-keda-queue
setups.controlPlane: KEDA on total queued requests (4 per replica)

setups.name: S3-static-partition
setups.controlPlane: none: pool fixed at capacity, guarantees as shares

setups.name: S4-flowcontrol-equiv
setups.controlPlane: KEDA on the gateway queue length (4 per replica)

setups.name: S4b-flowcontrol-outstanding
setups.controlPlane: sensitivity variant of S4: KEDA on outstanding requests, gateway queue + dispatched (4 per replica)

setups.name: S7nr-ts-no-reservation
setups.controlPlane: sensitivity variant of S7: TenantScaler controller without slot reservation
